The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] '''Mungo Park''' was situated near [[Fellowship Plaza]], a central location in the [[Senate District/Legends|capital region]] of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]]. Even during the early stages of the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|war]] for Coruscant between the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi]] and [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]]<ref name="Apocalypse" /> in [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]'' in [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of Staff/Legends|Chief of Staff]] [[Wynn Dorvan]] observed [[Youngling/Legends|children]] enjoying the park's giant [[negrav trampoline]], which sent them floating in the air, free to somersault and join in laughter.<ref name="Apocalypse" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mungo Park was introduced in the [[2012]] novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]'', written by [[Troy Denning]] as the finale to the ''[[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi]]'' series.<ref name="Apocalypse" />
